name: B10-0129/2024 (The Left) – Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a lasting peace between Armenia and Azerbaijan. It condemns Azerbaijan's forced displacement of about 100,000 ethnic Armenians from Nagorno-Karabakh and its poor human rights record. It asks the European Union to suspend its energy deal with Azerbaijan and urges Azerbaijan to release the 23 Armenian prisoners of war it still holds. It also says Azerbaijan should not host the COP29 climate summit while abuses continue. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to suspend its energy partnership with Azerbaijan.
- It calls for the release of 23 Armenian prisoners of war held in Azerbaijan.
- It says Azerbaijan's rights record makes it unfit to host COP29 in November 2024.
